verdict.rationale: Superset lets users hand off tasks to agents from inside the app. The prompt-first flow means you describe the task, pick an agent, and it starts immediately. You can also send element-level Design requests or PR diff feedback to a running agent, and schedule automations. However, the agents are third-party CLI tools (Claude Code, Codex, Amp, Gemini) that you bring yourself, not a first-party built-in assistant, and users describe the product as terminal-centric rather than chat-centric. Missing for 10: a native first-party built-in AI assistant, and independent hands-on corroboration of in-app delegation beyond orchestrating external CLI agents.
